query:

  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN nicheId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_niche,
  SUM(CASE WHEN nicheId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_niche
FROM companies;
